last_completed_event.summary: Persistent SecureBlob adapters are locked in Drive milestone report 14oph_EGYMuyMGANC_bZQu0k93m0TpQYN. Product commit 35c8e078e44d88b1e5d8937bcd008255b9ca87fa passed Product Boundary CI run 33720340472 and Product Construction CI run 33720340413. The strict versioned blob codec, traversal-safe canonical file naming, same-directory temporary writes, durable file flush, atomic replacement, interrupted-write cleanup, reference-based orphan cleanup, and corrupt-record preservation were proved by shared JVM contracts, Android API 35 runtime tests, and iOS Simulator ARM64 tests. This locks filesystem-backed encrypted payload persistence only; application startup orchestration, reference verification/decryption, and authorized search rehydration remain the next bounded checkpoint.

Keep UI, camera, OCR, PDF export, Foundry/source-aware artifacts, and dynamic behavioral-reference execution outside the slice.
